Hero.title: Software Engineer
Hero.description:
Transforming ideas into polished software. A Software Engineer dedicated to building accessible, high-performance web applications.
Based in Thessaloniki, Greece.

About.title: About Me
About.profileText1: I am a passionate Software Engineer currently advancing my expertise in Information and Electronic Systems Engineering at the International Hellenic University. With a coding background that began at age 16, I combine academic rigor with a hands-on approach to modern web development.
About.profileText2: I am driven by curiosity to learn and a commitment to quality. I stay ahead of the curve by continuously adapting to the latest tech trends and thrive in environments that challenge me to solve complex problems. Fluent in Greek and English.

description: Architecting and building scalable web solutions using .NET (Web API), Razor Pages, React, and Next.js.
Orchestrating DevOps workflows and deployments on Debian VPS using Docker, Docker Compose, and Azure.
Engineering automated testing suites using Python to ensure code reliability and performance.
Expanded platform functionality by developing new features tailored to business requirements.
Optimized application performance and resolved critical legacy issues to ensure system stability.
Founded and developed a full-stack media conversion platform using the Next.js framework.
Owned the entire product lifecycle, from UI/UX design to backend architecture and deployment.
Executed SEO strategies and performance optimizations to drive user traffic.
Collaborated with the core team to design and implement responsive UI components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Provided technical support and troubleshooting for hosting clients.
Debugged front-end issues and optimized code based on feedback from senior management.

robinrich.title: robinrich.gr
robinrich.description: Production maintenance and feature expansion for an active commercial platform. Successfully diagnosed and resolved legacy bugs while implementing new client-requested modules.
robinrich.problem: The platform had legacy code issues, slow page loads, and lacked key engagement features requested by customers.
robinrich.outcome: Resolved critical bugs, increased engagement by delivering new modules, and improved overall speed and UX.

mp3convert.title: mp3convert.tech
mp3convert.description: Advanced media tool leveraging client-side processing for conversion to minimize server load. Powered by a Next.js backend, integrated with a high-throughput Golang API for real-time streaming.
mp3convert.problem: Traditional media conversion requires heavy server resources, which scales poorly and incurs high hosting costs.
mp3convert.outcome: Drastically reduced server load by shifting processing to the client. Real-time streaming API handles throughput smoothly.

yt2mp3.title: yt2mp3.tech
yt2mp3.description: A comprehensive media SaaS platform. Handled the full product lifecycle from UI/UX design to deployment, focusing on responsive design and user retention.
yt2mp3.problem: There was a need for a highly reliable, fast, and user-friendly media conversion tool with good SEO standing.
yt2mp3.outcome: Attracted a steady user base, ranked well on search engines (SEO), and provided a seamless conversion experience.

modularReactBlog.title: Modular React Blog
modularReactBlog.description: A distinct exploration of component-based architecture. Built to demonstrate proficiency in React hooks, state management patterns, and dynamic routing.
modularReactBlog.problem: Traditional monolithic blogs are often hard to extend or customize dynamically without tight coupling.
modularReactBlog.outcome: Delivered a clean, modular architecture that is easily extensible, highly performant, and simple to maintain.

chaoticDestinyHosting.title: Chaotic Destiny Hosting
chaoticDestinyHosting.description: Front-end development for a hosting provider. Collaborated directly with management to translate business requirements into responsive web interfaces.
chaoticDestinyHosting.problem: The existing frontend was non-responsive and unintuitive, causing user drop-offs during the hosting checkout process.
chaoticDestinyHosting.outcome: Improved user navigation and reduced support requests by providing a clear, responsive, and modern interface.

Services.title: Services
Services.description: I provide complete technical solutions designed to save you time and add value to your business.

customWebApplications.title: Custom Web Applications

customWebApplications.outcome: Fully customized, scalable solutions that perfectly align with your business logic, increasing overall productivity.

eshopDevelopment.title: E-Commerce Development
eshopDevelopment.description: Modern online stores with secure payments and fast navigation, designed to boost your sales.
eshopDevelopment.problem: Slow, clunky, or unsecure online stores lead to high cart abandonment rates and lost revenue.
eshopDevelopment.outcome: High-conversion e-shops with lightning-fast load times, seamless checkout, and robust security.

corporateWebsiteDesign.title: Corporate Website Design
corporateWebsiteDesign.description: Professional, fast, and mobile-friendly websites that showcase your brand and attract new customers.
corporateWebsiteDesign.problem: A poor digital presence harms brand credibility and makes it difficult for potential clients to trust your business.
corporateWebsiteDesign.outcome: A stunning, highly-performant corporate site that ranks well on Google and converts visitors into leads.

maintenanceTechnicalSupport.title: Maintenance & Technical Support (SEO)
maintenanceTechnicalSupport.description: Continuous monitoring, speed optimization (SEO), security updates, and quick bug fixes to give you peace of mind.
maintenanceTechnicalSupport.problem: Without proper maintenance, websites degrade over time, become vulnerable to hacks, and lose SEO rankings.
maintenanceTechnicalSupport.stack: Automated Testing (Python), Docker, Azure, Uptime Monitoring
maintenanceTechnicalSupport.outcome: Guaranteed uptime, peak performance, and peace of mind knowing your digital assets are fully managed.
